stories.summary: Clone an existing catalog skill into a new skill folder, rewriting the SKILL.md frontmatter name and the verify.yaml skill value and leaving the source skill and main unchanged, and reject a missing source, a new name already on main or a new name used by an open build

Open an existing catalog skill in an edit build on a branch cut from main that reuses the existing skill folder and creates no second one, and reject a name absent from main, a skill used by an open build or an empty submission
